title: Finite-prime decomposition data for completion
statement:
theorem completion_finite_extension_decomposition
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    let A := Localization.AtPrime p
    let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
    let C := AdicCompletion m A
    let B := A ⊗[R] S
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := A) (B := S)
    let J := p.map (algebraMap R B)
    let Q := p.primesOver S
    let D := fun q : Q ↦
      AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.1))
        (Localization.AtPrime q.1)
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := C) (B := S)
    Finite Q ∧
      ∃ (e : (C ⊗[R] S) ≃ₐ[S] (∀ q : Q, D q))
        (g : ∀ q : Q, C →+* D q),
        (∀ (q : Q) (n : ℕ) (a : C) (r : A),
          AdicCompletion.evalₐ m n a = Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ n) r →
          AdicCompletion.evalₐ
              (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.1)) n (g q a) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk
              ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.1)) ^ n)
              (Localization.localRingHom p q.1 (algebraMap R S)
                (Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q.1) (p := p)) r)) ∧
        (∀ (a : C) (q : Q), e (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S)) q = g q a)

proof.text: Mathlib Algebra.QuasiFinite.finite_primesOver gives finiteness directly, using the instance that finite algebras are quasi-finite. The finiteness clause is recorded in the finite-spectrum node.

Each localRingHom maps the maximal ideal m into the maximal ideal n_q. Map A/m^k to S_q/n_q^k and compose with evalₐ. Quotient representatives and inverse-limit compatibility show that these ring maps commute with reduction. AdicCompletion.liftRingHom constructs g_q without existential choice; evalₐ_liftRingHom proves its levelwise equation. Extensionality of quotient coordinates proves compatibility with the R-algebra maps.

Use the product R-algebra map g and Algebra.TensorProduct.lift to construct f. Its value at 1 tensor s is the S-algebra map, so f is an S-algebra homomorphism. Its value at a tensor 1 in component q is g_q(a), proving the final compatibility equation.

Apply the injectivity and surjectivity statements to f and its proved levelwise formula. AlgEquiv.ofBijective constructs e from this bijective canonical map. Package e, g, finiteness, and the two compatibility equations.
